Welcome to ViVi Therapy founded in 2006 by Roxanne Derkson, Registered Massage Therapist and Feldenkrais Practitioner.   

Check out playlists & professionally curated content on the ABC's of studying massage from seeker to pro. Our massage videos will help you determine if you want to dive into a full length professional training or simply learn to massage your family, friends & people in need. You can help quelle an insatiable global need for bodywork.

Subscribe here to discover step by step from a master, what its like to start a career in massage.  Easy to follow content created for folks interested in learning to massage right from the beginning. Launching weekly step by step videos that could transform your life.

Learn more about  "ViVi" here. Watch our clinic tour, community events, product videos from ViVi massage supply store, and professional development training offerings. This channel was started in 2011 and contains content spanning more than a decade.
